name: verification_discover
description: Validate that a candidate parallel plan has unique task IDs and safe, exact, file-disjoint ownership; return structured issues for autonomous replanning.

subtasks.description: Candidate parallel plan to validate. Each item must be an object with a lowercase kebab-case 'id', a non-empty 'description', and a non-empty 'files' array of exact repository-relative paths not claimed by another subtask.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case slug uniquely identifying the subtask.

description.description: Non-empty human-readable description of the subtask.

files.description: Non-empty list of exact, repository-relative files this subtask owns.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository, used to reject files that resolve to directories rather than exact files. Defaults to no directory check when omitted.

currentSubtasks.description: The plan currently in flight, returned as-is under 'subtasks' when validation fails so a replan has something to fix instead of an empty list.

exhausted.description: Whether the replanning budget is exhausted; when true and validation fails, planningState is 'plan_exhausted' instead of 'needs_replan'. Defaults to false.

valid.description: True when every subtask passed validation with no issues.

planningState.description: Routable verdict: 'valid' to proceed, 'needs_replan' to retry planning, 'plan_exhausted' when the replan budget is spent.

issues.description: Structured validation issues found in the candidate plan; empty when valid.

code.description: Machine-readable issue code, e.g. empty_plan, invalid_id, duplicate_id, missing_description, missing_files, unsafe_path, directory_claim.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. subtasks[0].files[1].

subtask.description: The subtask id the issue relates to, when known.

subtasks.description: The normalized, validated plan when valid; otherwise currentSubtasks (or an empty array) so a repair round has a plan to fix.
